create_acagent_instance: create an ACAgent instance by passing an algo and storage object to the constructor
update_acagent: update the ACAgent by calling update with optional discard_grad and kl_dict parameters
act_with_acagent: act using the ACAgent by calling act with observation and recurrent hidden state arguments
get_value_from_acagent: get the value estimate from the ACAgent by calling get_value with the current observation
move_acagent_to_device: move the ACAgent and its storage to a target device like cuda by calling to
